SCHEDULE 4 - RECORDS MANAGEMENT
Synthetic test document. Fictional parties. No legal effect.
8.1 Retention. Records shall be retained for seven (7) years after the end of the relevant matter.
8.2 Storage. Physical records shall be stored in locked cabinets with access limited to authorised staff.
8.3 Disposal. Records shall be securely destroyed at the end of the retention period.
8.4 Transfers. Personal data shall not be transferred outside Examplestan without the prior written consent of the Client.
8.5 Training. Personnel shall complete data protection training once in every calendar year.
8.6 Registers. The Provider shall maintain a register of all processing activities.
8.7 Inspections. Regulators may inspect records during normal business hours on reasonable notice.
8.8 Remedies. Breach of this Schedule entitles the Client to terminate under Clause 9.1.
8.9 Survival. This Schedule survives termination for so long as the Provider holds personal data.
